status: exploratory joint protocol frozen after separate-track results and before any shared-parameter fit
question: Can one shared local-density response predict held-out BCG dynamics and held-out cluster weak lensing, and does measured BCG coherence improve that transfer?

domains.BCG: 44 Tian2024 MaNGA BCGs after the frozen DynPop quality selection; local Sersic density and C=Lambda_Re
domains.cluster: 14 Elkholy2015 gas-profile systems cross-matched to Herbonnet2020 weak-lensing aperture M500; nominal Mstar/Mgas=0.10 and C=0

models: universal CPR0 using measured BCG coherence and C=0 for clusters

cross_validation.split: separate deterministic system-level folds within each domain; every held-out fold contains both domains

claim_boundary: This joint exercise is exploratory because both separate-domain outcomes were inspected before this protocol was frozen.
System-level cross-validation prevents row leakage but does not provide a pristine external validation set.
A good score across disjoint density ranges can be a two-plateau interpolation rather than evidence for the transition law.
The density gap must pass its own gate before a shared fit can count as support for a continuous unification.
The model still lacks a relativistic action and derived photon propagation; cluster lensing is scored with a zero-slip effective-acceleration mapping.
